نصطلي (form VIII)
# نَصْطَلِي (naṣṭalī) /nasˤ.tˤa.liː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِصْطَلَى (iṣṭalā)
# نَصْطَلِيَ (naṣṭaliya) /nasˤ.tˤa.li.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَلَى (iṣṭalā)
